motivation: The collision-safe A+B deterministic model selected maximum ridge regularization and produced only negligible retrospective validation improvement. Test a more specific objective local-organization feature already present in the same pre-election closed universe before considering any LLM treatment.

feature_C.definition: The focal legislative head of list is resolved to an elected 2015 communal-council member whose elections.ma/TAFRA record has teteDeListe=1.
feature_C.source: same complete TAFRA copy of elections.ma communal elected-member universe used for feature B
feature_C.missing_rule: UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN when candidate identity is not collision-resolved. A candidate verified absent from the complete elected-member universe is FALSE.

model_selection.criterion: lowest leave-one-region-out PJD share RMSE on 2011_TO_2016

validation.rule: Apply the single model family and ridge value selected exclusively on 2016 without alteration. Report PJD and all-party metrics plus paired bootstrap; do not choose among model families after inspecting 2021.

forbidden: Select feature C because of its 2021 performance
Use 2021 to choose model family or ridge strength
Add an interaction after seeing results
Invoke an LLM before deterministic feature expansion is measured
